items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: He said — Gene Hackman, the daughter

ctx.x: He said — Gene Hackman, the daughter — he’s got a bunch of dysfunctional kids, so one of the daughters says, “You don’t even know my middle name.” And he says, “That’s a trick question.”
